jobs.title: Group Head of Financial Risk
jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

You will join the Group Financial Risk team, which safeguards the Group’s financial soundness through an independent, forward-looking view of market, counterparty and ALM risks. The unit oversees the risk management framework for the Trading and Banking Books, supporting prudent capital and balance sheet management, effective internal controls and regulatory compliance. Its data-driven analytics inform strategic decisions and foster a strong risk culture across all entities. As Group Head of Financial Risk, you will combine functional leadership and second-line oversight with hands-on involvement in risk analysis, stress testing, monitoring, reporting, policy development and risk assessments. Drawing on strong technical expertise and strategic judgement, you will provide independent challenge and advise senior management, while supporting the Group Head of Risk in governance, escalation and regulatory interactions.

Your role

You will be responsible for:

• Maintain and enhance the Group's framework, policies, methodologies and standards for Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, IRRBB and Counterparty Risk.
• Ensure alignment with the Group's risk appetite, strategic objectives and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Contribute to the definition and periodic review of risk appetite metrics, limits and risk tolerances.
• Provide independent financial risk expertise and advice to senior management and governance committees.
• Drive continuous improvements in risk methodologies, monitoring capabilities, reporting and governance practices.
• Maintain an independent assessment of the Group's financial risk profile.
• Perform and oversee risk analyses, stress testing, thematic reviews and investigations into emerging risks.
• Challenge risk assessments, methodologies, assumptions, limits and mitigation measures developed by the First Lines of Defence.
• Review material exposures, concentrations, limit breaches and significant changes in the risk environment, ensuring timely escalation where appropriate.
• Provide independent opinions on significant transactions, initiatives and risk-taking activities.
• Oversee the monitoring of market, liquidity, interest rate and counterparty risk exposures across the Group.
• Produce and present clear, timely and decision-oriented risk reporting to senior management and governance bodies.
• Escalate significant risk developments and provide recommendations on mitigating actions.
• Support assessments of the Group's balance sheet resilience and overall financial risk profile.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance or Science (engineering, mathematics etc) or qualification deemed equivalent. CFA, CAIA, CIIA or equivalent post-grade.
• Minimum 10 years’ experience in financial risk management within a banking or investment-led environment, including significant exposure to market, liquidity, IRRBB and counterparty risk.
• Proven track record in designing, enhancing and overseeing complex financial risk frameworks at Group or large-entity level, including risk appetite, policies, limits and control frameworks.
• Deep technical expertise in derivative products, trading strategies, valuation and risk measurement methodologies, as well as relevant prudential and market regulations.
• Familiarity with risk and trading systems (e.g. Front Arena, RiskPro, Avaloq) and with data / reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, SQL or similar) is an advantage; ability to interpret and challenge quantitative analysis.
• Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
• Excellent organisational, interpersonal and communication skills.
• Fluent in French and English
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : GHFR/MH/PB

jobs.title: Senior Public Equity Analyst
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group offers comprehensive services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

The Pictet Investment Office (PIO) is a specialised investment team within Pictet Wealth Management, dedicated to serving a select group of large families and principals. It manages substantial wealth portfolios through a distinctive approach that combines investments across public and private markets, with a strong emphasis on equity ownership and concentrated conviction.

The service is designed for large wealth owners with a multi-generational horizon and limited liquidity requirements, allowing them to fully benefit from the power of compounding. PIO’s investment philosophy centres on long-term business ownership, unconstrained capital allocation, and the belief that permanent capital loss, rather than volatility, is the only real risk. This exclusive offering operates within Pictet’s broader wealth management business, which oversees CHF 277bn in assets and provides comprehensive, bespoke private banking services.

Your role

• Investment idea generation: Identify and develop high-conviction, long-term, long-only investment opportunities in US and European markets.
• Fundamental analysis: Perform comprehensive due diligence on investment ideas, including industry analysis, financial modelling and valuation. Engage directly with company management and perform primary research to support investment theses.
• Sector coverage: Cover sectors as assigned, with flexibility to adapt as team needs evolve. Experience in the sectors in which we principally invest is advantageous but not required (technology, business services, non-bank financials, healthcare services and devices, industrial technologies, infrastructure).
• Reporting and communication: Prepare and present investment reports and recommendations to the team and investment leadership.
• Curiosity: Actively engage on team debate and discussions that sit outside of your area of expertise. Contribute to building the team’s broad-based knowledge and experience set to enhance the quality of investment debate.
• Team collaboration: Work closely with other analysts to share ideas, insights and best practices in a highly collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.
• Cross asset class: Contribute to the research effort on other asset classes, including Private Equity and Hedge Funds where necessary.
• Data and process improvement: Leverage investment experience to support data-driven projects and process improvements, including the integration of advanced analytics and emerging AI tools.

Your profile

• Education: Graduate degree from a top-tier university with an outstanding academic record.
• Experience: Minimum of 10 years in sell-side or buy-side roles (asset management, hedge funds, or private equity). Experience in fundamental, long-term orientated investment process is preferred.
• Technical skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and data management. Experience or interest in data-driven projects and process improvement; familiarity with AI concepts is preferred.
• Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
• Passion: Can demonstrate a deep passion for investing, exceptionally curious to understand why some companies win or lose, and what will shape industries, and sectors and companies in the future.
• Financial and investment excellence: Strong grounding in fundamental analysis and financial modelling skills with the ability to generate high conviction, long-term investment ideas in a rigorous quality and fundamentally based framework.
• Analytical mindset: Thrives in an evidence-based, truth-seeking culture. Exceptional proficiency in Excel and data organization. Comfortable and open to learning and implementing new technologies and AI-enhanced processes.
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present investment ideas and reports clearly and persuasively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Teamwork: Strong collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit, with a focus on both contributing ideas and supporting the team’s collective success through active debate and discussion on the entire team’s work.
• Integrity: High ethical standards and alignment with the values and culture of the Pictet Investment Office.
• Intellectual curiosity: Deep passion for investing and a desire to continuously learn and improve.
• Work ethic: Highly motivated, proactive and results-oriented.
• Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical behaviour and professional standards.

La tua squadra

Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre servizi completi per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Il Pictet Investment Office (PIO) è un team di investimento specializzato all'interno della Pictet Wealth Management, dedicato a servire un gruppo selezionato di famiglie e preside. Gestisce portafogli di ricchezza sostanziali attraverso un approccio distintivo che combina gli investimenti in mercati pubblici e privati, con una forte enfasi sulla proprietà azionaria e sulla convinzione concentrata.

Il servizio è progettato per grandi proprietari di ricchezza con un orizzonte multi-generazionale e requisiti di liquidità limitati, permettendo loro di beneficiare pienamente della potenza di compounding. La filosofia di investimento di PIO si concentra sulla proprietà aziendale a lungo termine, sull’allocazione di capitale non vincolata, e la convinzione che la perdita di capitale permanente, piuttosto che la volatilità, è l’unico rischio reale. Questa offerta esclusiva opera all’interno della più ampia attività di gestione patrimoniale di Pictet, che sovrintende a CHF 277 miliardi di attività e fornisce servizi bancari privati completi e su misura.

Il tuo ruolo

• Generazione di idee per gli investimenti: Identificare e sviluppare opportunità di investimento ad alta concorrenza, a lungo termine, a lungo termine nei mercati statunitensi ed europei.
• Analisi di base: Eseguire la dovuta diligenza completa sulle idee di investimento, tra cui l'analisi del settore, la modellazione finanziaria e la valutazione. Coinvolgere direttamente con la gestione aziendale e svolgere ricerche primarie per sostenere le tesi di investimento.
• Copertura del settore: Settori di copertura assegnati, con flessibilità per adattarsi alle esigenze del team. L'esperienza nei settori in cui investiamo principalmente è vantaggiosa ma non necessaria (tecnologia, servizi di business, finanza non bancaria, servizi sanitari e dispositivi, tecnologie industriali, infrastrutture).
• Reporting e comunicazione: Preparare e presentare rapporti di investimento e raccomandazioni al team e alla leadership di investimento.
• Curiosità: impegnarsi attivamente nel dibattito di squadra e discussioni che siedono al di fuori della vostra area di competenza. Contribuire a costruire la conoscenza e l’esperienza di ampio respiro del team per migliorare la qualità del dibattito sugli investimenti.
• Collaborazione di gruppo: Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri analisti per condividere idee, approfondimenti e migliori pratiche in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e imprenditoriale.
• Cross asset class: Contribuisci allo sforzo di ricerca su altre classi di asset, tra cui Private Equity and Hedge Funds, se necessario.
• Miglioramento dei dati e dei processi: esperienza di investimento Leverage per supportare i progetti basati sui dati e i miglioramenti dei processi, compresa l'integrazione di strumenti avanzati di analisi e AI.

Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione: Laurea in un'università superiore con un record accademico eccezionale.
• Esperienza: Minimo di 10 anni in ruoli di vendita o buy-side (gestione valuta, hedge fund, o private equity). L'esperienza nel processo di investimento orientato a lungo termine fondamentale è preferita.
• Abilità tecniche: competenza avanzata in Excel e gestione dei dati. Esperienza o interesse nei progetti basati sui dati e miglioramento dei processi; la familiarità con i concetti AI è preferita.
• Lingue: Fluency in Inglese richiesto. Le lingue aggiuntive sono un plus.
• Passione: Può dimostrare una profonda passione per gli investimenti, eccezionalmente curioso di capire perché alcune aziende vincono o perdono, e che cosa formerà industrie, settori e aziende in futuro.
• Eccellenza finanziaria e di investimento: Forte radicamento nelle competenze fondamentali di analisi e modellazione finanziaria con la capacità di generare idee di investimento ad alta convinzione e a lungo termine in una qualità rigorosa e struttura fondamentalmente basata.
• Mindset analitico: Thrives in una cultura basata sulle prove, che cerca la verità. Eccezionale competenza in Excel e organizzazione dei dati. Confortevole e aperto all'apprendimento e all'attuazione di nuove tecnologie e processi potenziati dall'intelligenza artificiale.
• Comunicazione: Eccellente capacità comunicative verbali e scritte, con la capacità di presentare idee di investimento e report chiaramente e persuasivo sia agli stakeholder interni che esterni.
• Lavoro di squadra: forte spirito collaborativo e imprenditoriale, con l’attenzione sia sul contributo delle idee sia sul sostegno del successo collettivo del team attraverso il dibattito attivo e la discussione sul lavoro dell’intero team.
• Integrità: elevati standard etici e allineamento con i valori e la cultura dell'Ufficio Investimenti Pictet.
• Curiosità intellettuale: profonda passione per gli investimenti e il desiderio di imparare e migliorare continuamente.
• Etica del lavoro: altamente motivato, proattivo e orientato ai risultati.
• Integrità: Impegno costante al comportamento etico e agli standard professionali.

Nota

Your team

Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while also supporting its day-to-day operations.

Build the practice. Develop our people. Bring AI expertise closer to every business line that needs it.

You will join Pictet as the first Chapter Lead of the Forward-Deployed Engineering (FDE) Chapter, a new unit created to embed hands-on AI and generative AI (GenAI) engineering expertise directly within business and product teams. You will shape how the Chapter operates: there is no existing playbook to inherit and no predecessor to follow.

You will report to the Head of Group Technology Strategy and Innovation and work closely with the AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE), which develops the reusable AI platforms, agent blueprints and GenAI capabilities that support the Group. While AI CoE teams build capabilities for use across the Group, your Chapter will embed engineers within the business, one assignment at a time.

Your role

• Building and leading the FDE Chapter
 Establish and develop the Forward-Deployed Engineering (FDE) Chapter, while defining common standards and ways of working across different engagement models. This will include setting expectations for assignment scoping, discovery, technical delivery, production readiness and escalation. Lead the onboarding, mentoring and professional development of FDEs, creating a consistent framework across all assignments.

• Managing FDE allocation and engagements
 Work with business-line leaders to identify and prioritise FDE engagements based on business needs, strategic relevance and available expertise. Define the scope and expected outcomes of each engagement, monitor progress and ensure that evolving requirements are managed appropriately. Determine when assignments have been completed and when FDE resources should be reassigned to new priorities.

• Providing technical and delivery leadership
Remain closely involved in key FDE engagements and provide hands-on support when required. Apply your technical expertise to review architectural decisions, challenge technical approaches and help resolve complex delivery issues. Engage directly with senior stakeholders when additional alignment or intervention is required.

Build and develop the FDE talent pool through recruitment, skills development and career management. Establish strong relationships across the business lines and position the Chapter as a recognised centre of expertise in Forward-Deployed Engineering. Represent the Chapter to senior stakeholders, working closely with the AI Centre of Excellence.

Your profile

• Several years’ experience leading engineering teams, ideally within distributed, embedded or matrix-based operating models.

• Extensive hands-on experience in AI and generative AI, combined with a strong engineering background and the ability to provide credible technical leadership.

• Experience of working in evolving environments and establishing new structures, standards and ways of working.

Stabilire forti relazioni tra le linee di business e posizionare il Capitolo come centro riconosciuto di competenza in Ingegneria avanzata. Your team

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

The Investment & Customized Reporting team within Pictet Asset Services brings together experienced professionals specializing in investment reporting and customized reporting solutions for our clients. Working closely with our Data team, we design and deliver bespoke reporting solutions tailored to the needs of institutional and sophisticated clients, mainly Pension funds and Asset managers. From onboarding onward, we help clients define and address their requirements in areas such as asset allocation, performance, risk analysis, transactions and investment reporting.

Your role

You will contribute to the production, development and enhancement of investment and customized reports for our sophisticated clients, with the support and guidance of experienced team members. In particular, you will:
• Support client onboarding by analyzing reporting requirements and translating client needs into appropriate solutions.
• Respond directly to clients and internal stakeholders regarding complex reporting and performance-related queries.
• Produce, maintain and continuously improve customized reports for institutional clients.
• Perform quality controls on portfolio and performance data to ensure accurate, consistent and timely delivery of client reports.
• Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and process optimization, and contribute actively to the team’s continuous-improvement and digitalization initiatives.
• Participate in the development, testing and implementation of new reporting solutions and enhancements.
• Work closely with the Data team, IT and other Pictet teams to improve data quality, reporting processes and client solutions.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Finance with a strong Data Analytics component.
• Junior profile with no more than two years of professional experience after completing their studies.
• Willingness to undertake relevant continuing education alongside the role.
• A strong interest in data, automation, digitalization and AI applied to portfolio reporting for very large institutional clients.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; initial exposure to Python and SQL is a must-have. Some knowledge of Snowflake would be an asset.
• A good understanding of financial instruments, portfolio transactions and investment concepts.
• Basic knowledge of performance measurement and risk analytics.
• Knowledge of private assets, including their specific valuation, performance measurement and reporting considerations, would be an asset.
• Rigorous, analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data quality and accuracy.
• Client- and service-oriented, able to understand requirements and translate them into pragmatic solutions.

• Eseguire controlli di qualità su dati di portafoglio e prestazioni per garantire la consegna accurata, coerente e tempestiva dei report dei clienti.
• Identificare le opportunità di automazione, standardizzazione e ottimizzazione dei processi e contribuire attivamente alle iniziative di miglioramento continuo e digitalizzazione del team.
• Partecipa allo sviluppo, alla sperimentazione e all'implementazione di nuove soluzioni di reportistica e miglioramenti.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team Data, IT e altri team Pictet per migliorare la qualità dei dati, i processi di reporting e le soluzioni client.

• Laurea magistrale in Finanza con un forte componente Data Analytics.
• Profilo Junior con non più di due anni di esperienza professionale dopo aver completato i loro studi.
• La volontà di intraprendere una formazione continua rilevante a fianco del ruolo.
• Un forte interesse per i dati, l'automazione, la digitalizzazione e l'AI hanno applicato alla segnalazione di portafoglio per i clienti istituzionali di grandi dimensioni.
• La competenza avanzata in Microsoft Excel; l'esposizione iniziale a Python e SQL è un must-have. Una certa conoscenza di Snowflake sarebbe una risorsa.
• Una buona comprensione di strumenti finanziari, transazioni di portafoglio e concetti di investimento.
• Conoscenza di base della misurazione delle prestazioni e analisi dei rischi.

• Client- e service-oriented, in grado di comprendere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni pragmatiche.
• Eccellente capacità di problem solving, con la capacità di indagare problemi complessi nei dati finanziari.

With teams based globally, PAA constructs, manages and advises portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.
You will be part of a team of 20 professionals dedicated to Pictet’s pan-European Direct Real Estate franchise, which began in 2019 with the launch of Elevation Fund I, a EUR 700 million value-add fund. Elevation Fund II was launched in 2023, and a Core Plus fund, with approximately EUR 200 million under management, was launched in 2021. The team is distributed across several locations: in London, where the core investment and asset management teams are based; in Geneva, where the investment legal and investor relations teams operate; and in Berlin and Stockholm, where our regional heads are located. Additionally, fund support functions such as fund administration, compliance, and legal affairs are situated in Luxembourg and London.

Your role

As part of the Direct Real Estate team based in Geneva you will:

• Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of real estate and financing documents, including shareholders’ agreements, financing agreements, lease agreements, SPAs, construction agreements, etc.

• Support direct real estate transactions from inception to closing, helping to drive execution by coordinating legal workstreams, managing negotiations and liaising with internal stakeholders and external advisers.

• Act as a key legal partner on cross-border matters, working closely with internal teams across jurisdictions on transaction status, documentation, payment mechanics and related execution steps.

• Provide day-to-day legal support on asset management and project matters, combining strong technical legal drafting with a practical, commercially minded and solutions-oriented approach to business issues, focused on finding practical solutions to the team’s challenges rather than acting solely as a gatekeeper.

• Lead and support legal documentation for development, construction and refurbishment matters, including preparing, revising and finalising project and works contracts for counterparties.

Your profile

• Between 5 and 8 years post-qualification in the real estate department of a major and reputable law firm ideally completed by in-house experience, and have experienced leading acquisitions, disposals and financings (beyond due diligence support or minor supporting roles).

• Experience working on transactions in at least 3 different jurisdictions.

• The candidate should have flexibility to travel within Europe for business purposes.

• Fluent in English, any additional European language such as French, Spanish, German or Danish would be an asset.

• You have a particular interest of and existing experience with AI tools for task/workflow automation.

• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the selected candidate, you have developed a passion for real estate and are seeking to be involved in exciting real estate projects.
